task.description: Implement OIDC-01 per src/design/oidc-01-pluggable-provider-interface.md. Add a provider-agnostic IdentityProvider interface and module boundaries so non-adapter auth paths depend only on the interface (not Keycloak specifics). Ensure the interface covers token verification, user lookup, realm/tenant provisioning, user provisioning, role grant management, client provisioning, IDP federation management, and audit event retrieval. Keep Keycloak-specific behavior isolated to adapter package paths. Update tests as needed to prove OIDC-01 acceptance criteria and run mandatory backend validation commands.
acceptance_criteria: No Keycloak-specific references outside adapter package in non-adapter authentication paths
IdentityProvider contract is implemented and used by auth subsystem call paths
Build/test/migrate validations pass per backend workflow requirements
OIDC-01 acceptance criteria are covered by tests or verifiable assertions in artifacts

result.summary: Implemented OIDC-01 provider abstraction with a full IdentityProvider contract, added provider manager and adapter boundaries, wired auth middleware to use interface-driven JWT-like verification with no adapter coupling, and added unit coverage for successful and failed provider verification paths.
